parsed.rationale: All four participating records are anonymous extensions (name is empty string, fields_or_signature is empty) spread across test files in the Playback and MusicShareKit packages. The cluster carries no structural evidence — jaccard, shared_field_count, shared_ancestor, and differing_slots are all null — meaning the pipeline surfaced a name-collision signal on an empty name token rather than on any meaningful shared shape or content. There is nothing actionable to extract, consolidate, or generalize from unnamed, field-less extension stubs. Although the context flags do not formally mark these records as is_test=true, the file paths (MP3StreamerTests.swift, AudioEnginePlayerTests.swift, AuthNetworkClientE2ETests.swift) place every record unambiguously inside test targets, reinforcing that no production refactor is warranted.
